MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.

2. When practising Guided Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Guided Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Guided Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading.

3. When practising Listening for Gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Gist.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Gist.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Gist.

4. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.

5. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.

6. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
